ColumnSummary.title: ColumnSummary
ColumnSummary.description: One column as the profiler read it. Facts only: shape, missingness, and anything odd.

DatasetCreate.title: DatasetCreate
DatasetCreate.description: CSV only. The conversation starts with the causal question; nothing about the data is typed into a form.

DecisionView.title: DecisionView
DecisionView.description: The routing's decision as the page shows it.

DeclineView.title: DeclineView
DeclineView.description: Where the lane did not take the pack as given.

Edge.title: Edge
Edge.description: One arrow of a graph figure, with the addresses it rests on.

FeasibilityView.title: FeasibilityView
FeasibilityView.description: Where and why a lane stopped.

moment.title: Moment
moment.description: ready: made at the ready moment, before the run; run: made by the run

note.title: Note
note.description: one sentence on what the figure shows, in the question's words

draws_on.title: Draws On
draws_on.description: the memory and probe addresses the figure rests on

Mark.title: Mark
Mark.description: A reference line: the cutoff, the change period, a floor.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One node of a graph figure: a column, or the hidden factor.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: question: the causal question is being asked; ask: a field; after: the chat after a run

because.title: Because
because.description: the families that need these fields

QuestionView.title: QuestionView
QuestionView.description: The one question the desk asks this turn, as the page shows it: the field addresses it settles, its form, its chips.

figures.title: Figures
figures.description: the ready-moment figure first, then what the run left

key.title: Key
key.description: The series' address segment, computed here once so the page never rebuilds it.

Series.title: Series
Series.description: One drawn set of values. `x` is a level, a period, or a bin; `y` the number; `lo`/`hi` an interval; `n` the rows behind each point.
